title: McKelvey Engineering dean search committee appointed
summary_en: Provost Mark D. West has appointed a 13-member search committee to identify candidates for the position of dean of the McKelvey School of Engineering at Washington University in St. Louis.
title_cn: McKelvey Engineering dean search committee appointed

title: Mental health care before, after surgery improves recovery in older adults
summary_en: A clinical trial led by WashU Medicine researchers found that combining mental health coaching with medication optimization reduced post-surgery anxiety and depression in older adults.
title_cn: Mental health care before, after surgery improves recovery in older adults
